messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 22(2)

Article 22 EU declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery. 2. The EU declaration of incorporation shall have the model structure set out in Annex V, Part B. It shall be continually updated and shall be translated into the language or languages required by the Member State in which the partly completed machinery is placed on the market or is made available on the market.

response.text:
EU declaration of incorporation | hasModelStructure | model structure set out in Annex V, Part B | | shall have the model structure set out in Annex V, Part B
EU declaration of incorporation | shallBeContinuallyUpdated | the declaration itself | | It shall be continually updated
EU declaration of incorporation | shallBeTranslated | language or languages required by the Member State | where the partly completed machinery is placed on or made available on the market in that Member State | shall be translated into the language or languages required by the Member State in which the partly completed machinery is placed on the market or is made available on the market
